changelogHeadings: The intro lights the panel with each scene.

steps.title: Panel lights stay on
steps.body: Your panel's key lights now stay on. Choose how they behave in Settings → Panel → Key lights, and set the Backlight slider there. Click 'Play Panel Light Show' to see the panel light up.

steps.title: The intro lights the panel with each scene
steps.body: Each intro scene now has its own choreography on the physical panel: a dancing band, the sweep in step with the screen, knob banks counting one-two-three, trackball rings, the held key lighting up, and a chase on the last screen. Click 'Watch the Intro' and keep your eyes on the panel.

steps.title: Waves follow your hand
steps.body: Push a trackball and a wave of light travels the way you push it. Turn a knob and one calm ring spreads across the keys beside it. Switch knob waves and the red and green keys on or off in Settings → Panel.

steps.title: A calmer Rewind edge
steps.body: Hold Undo in Lightroom to enter Rewind. The glow along the edge of Lightroom's display is transparent, softly blurred and gently warped, and no longer flickers as you turn the wheel. Nothing changes on your other displays.

steps.title: A calmer Rewind wheel
steps.body: Turn the center ring slowly and each click moves exactly one stop. Faster turns travel further, more gently than before. The Rewind speed dial in Settings still sets how far a hard spin travels.

steps.title: Contact the maker
steps.body: Menu bar → Contact · Bug, Question, Idea, or Settings → Help. Pick a type, write your message and choose Email (private, to panalux@icloud.com) or GitHub (public). Your PanaLux version and connection status are added and nothing is sent until you press send in Mail or on GitHub. Click 'Open Contact' to try it.

steps.title: Sync Settings no longer beeps
steps.body: Sync Settings only works when two or more photos are selected in Lightroom. If it is greyed out, PanaLux now says so on screen instead of sending a shortcut that makes the Mac beep. Select several photos in the filmstrip, then press your Sync key.

steps.title: Start here: Print / Panel Guide
steps.body: The highlighted printer button in the app toolbar opens your panel reference. You can also use Help → Panel Reference · View / Print / Save…. The real guide is shown below so you can practice its controls here. This walkthrough changes no assignments or Lightroom settings.

steps.title: Hardware Color Indicators & Light Show
steps.body: Your Micro Color Panel now features active dual-color hardware lighting. Bypass illuminates Red in Lightroom Before view and White in After view; mode keys illuminate Green for Offset, Modifiers, Stills, Highlights, Loupe and Masks. In Rewind mode, Shift Up blinks green in direct correlation with your reverse wheel rotation speed. Click 'Play Light Show' to preview the full lighting choreography on your physical panel and screen.

steps.title: Find this walkthrough again
steps.body: Help → Show This Update's Walkthrough… replays these steps. Take the Hands-On Tour starts with this guide, then continues with panel practice. Quick Reference has the shortcut and export instructions; What’s New in the menu bar or Settings keeps the changelog. Click Done to mark this build's walkthrough complete. Later or closing the app keeps it unfinished.
